g.text: MarieRank2Convo1 begins.
I hope you do not think me rude for asking, but I am so terribly curious. Do you have a faith ? In the Luminaries or otherwise.
What if i said I was more interested in you, instead? Would that be blasphemous?
No, it wouldn't be rude at all.
[End.]
Update boolean DrifterMarie
It's... complicated. I believe there's something out there, but I don't really have a named faith.
Yes, I do. I have a faith I believe in, though it's not one you'd know.
I believe in the Luminaries, like you.
No, I don't. I don't believe in gods. Just science we don't understand yet.
I don't know, honestly. I think the world is too complicated for me to have the answer.
Chat ends.
Ah, oui ? What is this ? Quelle audace, I must say I am surprised at you ! I was not expecting...
Update boolean DrifterFaithPersonal
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Update boolean DrifterFaithAgnostic
But you are trying to distract me ! While I am not opposed, it is far too soon for such things, n'est pas ?
+5 Chemistry
Faith by any name I find beauty in. Tell me, is it new ? Old ? Would I recognize it at all ?

You do ! Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! To think someone holds the faith so far into the future, cela remplit mon cœur de joie. I am overwhelmed with joy. Though I think your time in the past may have had something to do with it, no ? Ah, no matter.
I respect your response. But I must ask, how are you so certain ? Is that not a kind of faith in itself ? And what is this... Indifférence of yours, if not a god ?
+10 Chemistry
I... would still like an answer to my question, s'il vous plait, if you do not mind. Though now you have me blushing !
Ah, oui. A wanderer, that is in your name. You have seen many cultures, many faiths, many worlds. Cela est très spirituel, non ? Collected parts of them like seashells.
I don't think you'd recognize it at all, no.
You might recognize parts of it. But other parts would be totally foreign to you.
I wonder, are you devout to one or the other ? Or do you seek the balance ?
I'm not perfectly certain I'm right, no one can be. But I still don't personally believe in gods.
I think religion exists to fill a hole in people's lives left by the fear of death and the unknown.
I don't know what the Indifference is, but it isn't a god. We just need to get to the bottom of it.
Aah, perhaps the wisest answer of them all! For who are we mere mortals - if we can still claim to be such - to pretend to draw out the design of the Gods ?
I think there is also something older, truer, and deeper that speaks to us all. A connective tissue, kind of.
Exactly. I see something beautiful in all of them, I don't know as anyone has it right or wrong.
Update boolean DrifterFaithYesForeign
Update boolean DrifterFaithYesSimilar
I find myself drawn more towards Sol.
I find myself drawn more towards Lua.
I seek balance. I think that's the natural order of things.
Update boolean DrifterFaithNoMaybe
Update boolean DrifterFaithNoFear
Update boolean DrifterFaithNoMITW
Oft have I sat in the sanctuary of my Cathédrale and spoken gleefully with strangers who have come to learn and nothing more.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Update boolean DrifterFaithSol
Update boolean DrifterFaithLua
Update boolean DrifterFaithBalance
Oui, je vois... You perhaps need your own "proof" to be certain? Nothing has happened in your own life to give you such an emotion, like we feel of faith and fervor ?
Oui, c'est vrai - that is true. Faith answers many questions for many souls. Do you not fear what may come after death ?
Comme c'est fascinant... and now there are two, who repeat the same words... the devil has whispered the same.
So curious of our faith but not wanting to say "yes, yes, this is the truth." I can only hope I gave them some part of our joy to take with them.
Je comprends et c'est magnifique. I have often wondered if the Luminaries did not wear other faces. Other names.
Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! How I would love to learn of your faith some day. To hear of your rituals.
Oh, comme c'est fascinant ! How I would love to hear how it is so aligned and yet so different some day.
+10 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
No, I just don't believe.
That's right. I've never... "felt" faith. Or needed it.
Everyone dies. To fear it is silly. It comes for us all. Or at least... it should.
I've died enough times. I don't fear what comes after. I'm eager for it.
+5 Chemistry
I'm a little surprised you're open to people not believing in your faith.
That's exactly it. I don't want to say one is "right" or "wrong."
They have been known to change their forms to please their followers in other sects. But that is my faith, not yours.
I'd like that.
I'm surprised you're open to the idea of other religions.
A wanderer after my own heart ! You bring such a smile to my face. I hope you do not lie to flatter me.
Aah, the wanderer follows the night's path like my dear Lyon. When he is ready, you should speak to him of his dark lady's ways, he will be overjoyed.
Balance without indecision. To journey through one's life, knowing when the sun must rise and the moon must answer it, but to never fall prey to doubt ?
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
It pains my heart to give him any manner of credence but in this ? Perhaps you should speak to him. Simply be wary. The devil plays a dangerous game.
I suppose that might be a surprise, to find someone who wears the cloth to not be strict in their expectations of others. I find preaching to those who are not seeking solace does not win much love.
+5 Chemistry
I simply hope your faith brings you peace ?
Ô joie ! I do so much love to learn. I have often wondered if the Luminaries did not wear other faces. Other names.
I suppose that might be a surprise, to find someone who wears the cloth to not be strict in their expectations of others. I find preaching to those who are not seeking solace does not win much love.
I simply wonder, does our faith bring you peace ?
That is a rare gift... and one I hope you wield. To linger at the crossroads too long is to be consumed by strife, I fear.
It must be a simpler life, then. To not live by the rules of gods and churches. I admit I am a little jealous.
Then I am jealous of you, wanderer ! To live so many centuries, devoid of the need to know the gods.
You sound like a disciple of Lua, and I mean that with no offense. Oui, the Crone comes for us all, and weeps her silver tears. But your words make me wonder...
Oui, it makes me wonder. I look upon you, the child, the devil, even Monsieur Loid, or le Cardinal... so many centuries stretch behind you all.
What kind of dangerous game?
He doesn't think the Man in the Wall is real, either?
+5 Chemistry
I am smiling at your wisdom and kindness towards the beliefs of others.
It doesn't.
I honestly don't think much about it.
It does.

They have been known to change their forms to please their followers in other sects. But that is my faith, not yours. I will not preach to those who are not seeking for solace. I find it does not win much love.
No, my faith is mine, and yours is your own. I simply hope it brings you peace ?
In the end, all must choose a path to walk. But the crossroads is where we must all begin, the balance is the foundation of all structures.
But, I wonder... does this not believing, does it bring you peace ?
Of whom do you speak of, when you say "it should" come for you all ? I look upon you, the child, the devil, even Monsieur Loid, or le Cardinal... so many centuries stretch behind you all.
I wonder how many centuries stretch before us now, before Lua will come for us. And I wonder how eagerly I will embrace her when that day should come. But that is my faith, not yours.
I do not know just yet. He keeps his schemes to himself like a good devil. But he believes in no gods. Save, perhaps, himself.
Non, he does not. He is much like you, he believes in no gods. Save, perhaps, himself.
Non, anyone who comes with an open mind shall be met with open arms.
I simply wonder, does this bring you peace ?
Update boolean DrifterFaithNoPeace
+10 Chemistry
+10 Chemistry
Update boolean DrifterCrossroads
+10 Chemistry
My jealousy abounds! It would consume me. I would... be eager to speak to you of this again, if you would allow me ? I do not wish to preach or pry. I do not wish to cause you distress.
Then I know my Sol smiles upon you, whether or not you pray to him, for you have found the only path that you need.
Aah, pardonne-moi ! Little Marie is preaching, how embarrassing ! I did not come here to lecture you like a schoolteacher.
I am deeply touched by your honesty, wanderer. I would... be eager to speak to you of this again, if you would allow me? I do not wish to preach or pry. I do not wish to cause you distress.
I am merely curious, and wish to aid you if I can. Please, tell me no, and we shall never speak of this again.
I wonder, may we speak of this again ? I am so very curious to know more.
No, thank you.
Of course.
Update boolean DrifterFaithStop
Merci, merci ! There is much trust in what you have just given me. I shall not waste it. Until then.
I understand completely, and I am not offended. Thank you for listening to me, and I am grateful for what you have shared. We shall speak on other matters, Sol knows we have plenty !
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
